payload.title: Declared-load critical bending stiffness of a single clamped-free ray (linear small-deformation surrogate)

source.access: Public repository file at an immutable commit (git locator in the title/locator). Only digests are carried; bytes are not embedded and no licence for the content is stated by this record. Claim statement is the producer's critical_stiffness field.

payload.context: Producer-derived number from exact rational arithmetic on DECLARED inputs (rho, V, CL, tributary width, ray length, validity thresholds). It is a threshold of the surrogate, not a property of any fish. Decision rule stated by the producer: If measured EI >= EI_crit_Nm2 the declared load stays inside the small-deformation limit for this geometry; if EI < EI_crit_Nm2 the linear model is invalid at the declared load and a large-deformation model (or a lower load) is required.
payload.statement: For the producer's declared request (canonical sha256 f276a86069b8577d...), in a linear static Euler-Bernoulli cantilever with a uniform line load from a declared lift-pressure proxy, the bending stiffness below which the declared small-deformation limits are exceeded is EI_crit = 1323/2048000 N m^2 (binding limit: tip_over_L).
assumptions: Euler-Bernoulli (no shear deformation), linear elastic, static, constant EI along the ray
single clamped-free cantilever ray; clamped base; free tip
load = mean aerodynamic lift-pressure proxy p = 0.5*rho*V^2*CL from DECLARED rho, V, CL; uniform along the ray and normal to it; NOT a measured fin pressure
line load q_line = p * tributary width (width declared, see load_bridge.inputs)
EI swept over an ASSUMED log-spaced range [1/1000000, 1] N m^2, 61 points; no biological calibration
small-deformation validity limits are DECLARED thresholds, not derived from material
limitations: Imported record of what the producer's receipt reports. Frontier did not execute this and no one has re-run it; the producer's own code produced both the claim and the result, so it is not independent evidence.
The request is labelled by its producer: DECLARED ILLUSTRATION: not produced by the dx-guilds solver; numbers are test values, not a design claim. Its numbers are test values, not a design claim.
EI is an ASSUMED log-spaced range (1/1000000 to 1 N m^2), not a measurement of any fin ray.
Producer states it does not establish: biological feasibility of any fin, ray or flight design
Producer states it does not establish: the stiffness EI of any real fish fin ray (it is an assumed range here)
Producer states it does not establish: fluid-structure interaction: the load is a fixed mean pressure proxy, not coupled to deformation
Producer states it does not establish: fin membrane, bilaminar hemitrich shear, active muscle control, ray taper, joints or viscoelasticity
Producer states it does not establish: large-deformation (elastica) behaviour: results beyond the declared small-deformation limit are flagged invalid
Producer states it does not establish: calibration of rho, CL, tributary width or ray length (all declared, none measured)
Producer states it does not establish: that the glide package's candidate is flyable (owned by the glide receipt, not by this package)
